cell_id.description: Id of the cell to change, as shown by Read

cell_index.description: 0-based index of the cell to change, for cells without ids

new_source.description: The whole new source of the cell, as plain text

cell_type.description: Type of the cell. Required for insert; with replace, changes the type

description.description: A short label of what this call works on or looks for, shown to the user as its row: a noun phrase of 2 to 6 words, no leading verb
